But here's the thing - you get many different bills from each "party". You can't really understand that until you live it.

You don't get "one bill" for a procedure!

The doctor bills you. The medical facility (where the doctor saw you) bills you. The lab (where the actual test was performed) bills you.

Each one of those needs to be covered separately by your insurance.

So when you want to make sure you are covered - you need to find a doctor that is covered. Then you need to find a facility willing to do the test that is covered, and that your doctor can work in (they can't find it for you...) then you need to choose which lab the doctor sends it to (because again the doctor doesn't know what your insurance covers)
